Functions, message standards and deployment modes are public; detailed performance and assurance specifications remain unavailable.
Canadian Army validation, follow-on integration and NATO exercise demonstration are separated from current configuration and deployment claims.
Testing and accelerator participation plus current contract facts are public, while customer, deliverable and acceptance detail remains incomplete.
The dossier retains contract and Additional Sale facts without converting them into procurement eligibility or fielding.
Separate public assistance bases and Calian/Kongsberg pathways are recorded with forward-looking and non-revenue limits.
The existing published email and telephone remain supported and were not restaged as a no-op change.
DJINN's latest amendment provides the durable dated activity; social-only announcements remain private discovery leads.
Company, Canadian government, NATO, procurement, patent, partner and independent publication lanes support the proposed refresh.
Product-lineage, programme-count, maturity, procurement, contract-scope and social-source tensions remain explicit reviewer warnings rather than silently resolved facts.

saturation.stopReason: The final bilingual and broad-web lanes added no durable product version, conformance certificate, customer acceptance, DJINN scope or current release result that would change the capability definition, reviewed relationships, material warnings or reviewer action.

warnings: ISED anchors operational validation to KILO, while FULCRUM is the current product; no first-party migration record proves that every validated KILO configuration is equivalent to current FULCRUM.

The NATO DIANA TACTIQL spotlight is explicitly written by TACTIQL. TRL 9, product-market fit, sales and NSPA or NCIA procurement-route claims remain company-authored and are not independently promoted as fact.
CanadaBuys discloses DJINN's title, value, dates and parties but not technical scope, deliverables, acceptance or deployment. The candidate does not assign DJINN to FULCRUM.
Later Testing Stream contracts CW2430527 and CW2439940 disclose values and dates but not sufficient product scope; contract values are not combined as revenue, spend or proof of outcomes.

No public conformance certificate, interface-control document, throughput or latency benchmark, security accreditation, classification level, supported-hardware list, pricing, licence terms or lead time was found.
Exercise and programme records establish participation and demonstrations, not operational fielding, procurement, universal performance or customer acceptance.
Calian and Kongsberg materials describe partnerships and forward-looking integration goals, not completed joint systems, customer contracts or delivered operational capability.

LinkedIn surfaced current release testing, a General Dynamics Mission Systems–Canada Battle Lab exploration and an NRC IRAP Defence Industry Assist claim; no sufficient durable source resolved these into candidate fields.
Public sources do not establish current shareholders, ownership percentages, ultimate beneficial ownership, current headcount, production capacity or a complete facility footprint.
